signing_method: GenLayerJS SDK; signer private keys read in memory from GenLayer CLI OS keychain; never persisted.
scope: Two-wallet SDK E2E: happy path, invalid-input failure, duplicate-request conflict, and cross-sender adversarial isolation with exact finalized readback.

steps.label: happy-wallet-a
steps.purpose: happy path from auxiliary wallet A

steps.label: conflict-replay-wallet-a
steps.purpose: replay of A request must not append or overwrite a receipt

steps.label: failure-invalid-wallet-b
steps.purpose: invalid request ID must fail without mutation

steps.label: happy-wallet-b
steps.purpose: independent happy path from auxiliary wallet B

steps.label: audit-shared-wallet-a
steps.purpose: adversarial baseline: A owns its shared-looking request ID

steps.label: audit-shared-wallet-b
steps.purpose: adversarial isolation: B can use same request ID without blocking or overwriting A
